actions.reason: Cache the most recent merge-only vocabulary prefix built by _build_vocab and reuse it when constructing a tokenizer whose merges extend that sequence. The save/load workload repeatedly builds vocabularies from extending merge prefixes, so this avoids recomputing byte concatenations for the unchanged prefix while preserving the returned dictionary contents.
